description: Rewrite an AI-generated article so it reads like a real person wrote it — model-backed, provider-agnostic, handles long multi-paragraph text via chunking.
name: humanize_text

model.description: Optional model override. Defaults to HUMANIZE_MODEL env var or llama3.1:8b.

text.description: The full article text to humanize (may be many paragraphs with markdown).
